name: Novo Nordisk
thesis: Held under a REVISED thesis (the original 20%+ GLP-1 growth thesis broke on US pricing). The bet now: 2026 revenue decline comes in BETTER than the -4% to -12% CER guide and better than Street, on solid pricing and/or volume - driven by oral Wegovy (genuinely market-expansionary; beating at launch), international expansion, share defense in select segments, next-gen pipeline (CagriSema NDA, amycretin), and a stable insulin base. View: the 2026 reset is a price-driven trough, not the structural top. This is explicitly a VOLUME + orals-expansion bet that must clear a falling-net-price curve (Medicare IRA cuts ~70% from list effective 2027). WHAT'S PRICED IN (2026-06): at ~10x and -40-50% off the $81 high with FY26 guided to an outright sales+profit DECLINE, NVO is priced as a challenged loser - so much of the patent + competition fear is already discounted (a CONTRARIAN value setup, not a momentum name). The patent cliff is BIFURCATED and NOT the near-term risk: the high-margin US pool is protected to ~2031 patent / ~2032 practical generics (EU ~2031-33), while the 2026 EM LOEs (CN/IN/BR/CA) are low-margin with a slow generic ramp. The live, less-priced variable is the COMPETITIVE trajectory vs Lilly - and the bar is low (NVO need only stop bleeding US share). Trap-vs-turn turns on the 2027 guide returning to growth + US share stabilization + the CagriSema/amycretin pipeline. ROLE: the cheap, asymmetric leg of a long-GLP-1 book - hold/don't capitulate at the trough; diversify the THEME (Roche/AZN/Amgen for pipeline breadth, or LLY on a pullback) rather than double the obesity bet.
verdict: Watch (held under revised thesis; original GLP-1-growth thesis broke on pricing)
key_driver: Whether 2026 is the price-driven trough: the 2027 CER guide returning to growth + US share stabilization vs Lilly + volume (oral Wegovy / amycretin) clearing the falling net-price curve

tier_1_kpis.name: 2026 CER revenue vs guidance and consensus (PRIMARY thesis bar)
tier_1_kpis.current: FY26 guide -4% to -12% CER (narrowed up from -5% to -13%); Q1'26 beat consensus; US ops -11% CER on lower realized price
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Actual CER revenue worse than the guidance midpoint AND/OR worse than consensus (the thesis is to BEAT the lowered bar)

tier_1_kpis.name: 2027 CER guide — return to growth (THE trap-vs-turn signpost)
tier_1_kpis.current: FY26 guided to DECLINE -4% to -12% CER (a 'reset year'); the 2027 outlook is the key tell on whether the trough is single-cycle pricing or a structural slide
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: 2027 guided to another decline / fails to return to growth -> confirms a structural slide (value trap), not a single-cycle reset

tier_1_kpis.name: Oral Wegovy (oral semaglutide 25mg) uptake
tier_1_kpis.current: ~$354M Q1'26, ~2x estimates, 2M+ scripts - the strongest-ever GLP-1 volume launch; the market-expansion engine
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Oral Wegovy scripts stall, OR Lilly orforglipron (no food restrictions) takes the oral share before Novo scales it

tier_1_kpis.name: US net price / realization
tier_1_kpis.current: US ops -11% CER Q1'26 on price; Medicare IRA negotiated ~70% off list for Ozempic/Wegovy effective 2027
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Net-price decline accelerates beyond plan (price compression overwhelms volume)

tier_1_kpis.current: TBD — requires external data source (IQVIA / sell-side aggregation / transcript readouts)

tier_1_kpis.current: Wegovy +134% FY25 sales (CER); Ozempic Q4'25 +1% CER (units flat-ish, price compressed)

tier_1_kpis.name: Novo GLP-1 market share (diabetes vs Lilly tirzepatide; obesity vs Zepbound)
tier_1_kpis.current: TBD — diabetes share historically ~55%+; obesity LOSING US share - Mounjaro 23.4% vs Wegovy 16.5% of GLP-1 TRx; Zepbound US +79% while Novo US fell
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Obesity share loss >300bps in 2 consecutive Qs, OR diabetes share <40%

tier_1_kpis.name: Patent cliff — BIFURCATED (US/EU distant & high-margin vs 2026 EM LOE low-margin)
tier_1_kpis.current: High-margin US protected to ~2031 patent / ~2032 practical generics; EU ~2031-33. 2026 LOEs (CN/IN/BR/CA) are LOW-margin + slow ramp (no China generics ~1mo post-expiry). Material US cliff is ~6yrs out and largely priced at ~10x.
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: A 2026 EM LOE is immaterial (low-margin); the real watch is a US/EU challenge that PULLS FORWARD the ~2031-32 cliff, OR EM erosion proving faster/larger than the low-margin assumption
tier_1_kpis.source: annual report IP disclosures + jurisdiction patent registers (see directives/nvo_external_sources.md)

tier_1_kpis.name: CagriSema regulatory milestones
tier_1_kpis.current: NDA filed; PDUFA ~Oct 2026. REDEFINE 1 weight loss 22.7%; head-to-head vs Zepbound 20.4% vs ~24% (missed clean superiority). Higher-dose Ph3 H2'26; REDEFINE-11 data H1'27.
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: NDA rejected, label restricted, or follow-on trial readouts disappoint
tier_1_kpis.source: FDA approval calendar + Novo press releases

tier_1_kpis.name: Amycretin / zenagamtide Phase 3 (AMAZE) — next-gen GLP-1/amylin
tier_1_kpis.current: SC + oral amycretin (rebranded zenagamtide) entered Phase 3 AMAZE Q1'26; the long-term franchise-defense asset vs Lilly retatrutide/orforglipron
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: AMAZE delays, or efficacy/tolerability disappoints vs Lilly's next-gen -> erodes the pipeline pillar of the hold
tier_1_kpis.source: Novo pipeline updates + ADA / clinical readouts

nuance.bear_case: It is a PRICE problem more than a volume problem: 2026 guide is -4% to -12% sales, US -11% in Q1 on price, and Medicare IRA cuts Ozempic/Wegovy ~70% from list effective 2027 (MFN/net-price pressure on top). Share is also moving the wrong way in the US - Mounjaro 23.4% vs Wegovy 16.5% of GLP-1 TRx, Zepbound US +79% while Novo US fell - and Lilly's oral orforglipron (no food/water restrictions, likely cheaper small molecule) threatens to cap Novo's oral first-mover window to ~12-18 months. CagriSema's REDEFINE 1 landed at 22.7% weight loss, short of the ~25% bar the market wanted for clear superiority over tirzepatide. The CEO departed under duress after the ~50% drawdown and the board is reconstituting. 'Too draconian' requires being right on net PRICE, not just volume.
nuance.adversarial_take: CagriSema is 12-18 months from meaningful revenue under optimistic timelines, AND Lilly retatrutide could pre-empt any clean CagriSema launch window. Holding requires conviction that the 2026 trough is single-cycle pricing, not the start of a multi-year volume-share-price compression spiral.
nuance.stress_test: If 2026 actuals come in worse than -13% CER guide AND Wegovy Q-over-Q volumes decelerate AND Lilly retatrutide approval comes through, the position may need to be cut even before CagriSema readouts.
nuance.valuation_whats_priced_in: At ~$43 / ~10x earnings, down ~40% over 12mo (~50% from the $81 high) with FY26 guided to an outright sales+profit DECLINE (-4% to -12% CER), NVO is priced as a challenged loser, not a compounder - so much of the patent + competition fear is already discounted (target dispersion $40-175 = genuine debate; Goldman $41 bear vs Cantor $160 bull). Patent cliff is bifurcated: the material US pool is protected to ~2031 patent / ~2032 practical generics (EU ~2031-33), so at 10x you barely pay for post-2031 - the cliff is well-discounted; the 2026 EM LOEs (CN/IN/BR/CA) are low-margin with a slow generic ramp. The genuinely-unresolved variable is the competitive / deceleration trajectory: is 2026 THE trough (stabilize -> re-rate) or the start of a structural slide (value trap)? The bar is LOW - NVO need only stop bleeding US share. PORTFOLIO ROLE: the cheap, asymmetric leg of a long-GLP-1-theme book - hold / don't capitulate to chase Lilly at its high; diversify the THEME (Roche/AZN/Amgen for pipeline breadth, or LLY on a pullback) rather than concentrate the obesity bet.
signposts_trap_vs_turn: 2027 CER guide returns to growth (the single most important tell)
US Rx-share stabilizing vs Lilly (stop the bleed)
Oral Wegovy/Ozempic US ramp (oral Ozempic T2D cleared; 25mg decision end-2026)
Realized net-price / margin trend under IRA (~70% off list 2027) + MFN

data_note: Novo reports in DKK at constant exchange rates (CER); the universal USD-based break rules are FX-distorted - judge the thesis on CER growth vs guide/consensus, not USD.
competitive_watchlist: Eli Lilly — the share winner: Foundayo (oral orforglipron) approved Apr'26; retatrutide TRIUMPH-1 28.3%; Zepbound outgrowing Wegovy
Roche — deepest non-leader pipeline: CT-388/enicepatide dual GIP/GLP-1 (Ph2 22.5% placebo-adj @48wk) + petrelintide (amylin, via Zealand)
AstraZeneca — elecoglipron (oral GLP-1, Ph3 H2'26) + AZD6234 (amylin) + AZD9550; CSPC deal
Pfizer — acquired Metsera ($4.9B, beat Novo): MET-097i monthly GLP-1 + MET-233i amylin + orals
Amgen — MariTide (monthly GLP-1/GIP, Ph3 MARITIME ongoing; Ph2 ~16-20% but GI tolerability/discontinuation risk)

CagriSema NDA rejected or label restricted
Diabetes share loss to Lilly tirzepatide accelerating below 40%

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

business_model_rules.narrative: Revenue YoY < 12% for 2Q — sub-cycle floor for a name with Wegovy supply ramp; sub-12 means GLP-1 share is being lost.
Op margin < 30% for 2Q — NVO runs 35-45% historically; sub-30 means Wegovy capacity capex is no longer being absorbed into operating leverage.
GM < 75% for 2Q — pricing/cost mix degrading; biologics should sustain low-80s.
Capex/Revenue > 30% for 2Q — Wegovy capacity buildout was the thesis through FY26; sustained >30% past FY27 means capex is no longer cycling down with capacity in place.
